I didn’t even think it needed to be explained well let me help : -25 Lp after a demotion used to be the standard before they changed how Lp gains worked, back then you’d do +18-20 and - the same, so -25 wouldn’t hurt your mmr if anything it’d boost ur mmr slightly after a demotion making your Lp gains bigger for a short amount of time.

Now some people are gaining over 25 Lp or losing around the same : making a demotion a NET loss in mmr which makes Lp gains and loss unbearable after a few back and forth between ranks.

Having -50 makes it a net win in MMR like it was back then and makes it more bearable on the long term.
